messages.subject: Data from Michael Betancourt's mlss14 talk
parts:
Hello,

I've been trying to find the data that goes with the Gaussian process example and I was wondering if it is posted anywhere in examples-models.  The original link was www.mc-stan.org/mlss14/support.data.R.  I was able to scrape the first 20 years or so from the video, but it would be nice to have the rest.

Gene Quinn

Be careful — as we’ve learned how to better diagnose HMC fits we’ve
discovered that this model didn’t fit as well as originally thought.  In particular
the hyperparameters were pretty poorly identified which makes complete
sampling difficult.
